programme.title: Esprit D'Amour
programme.desc: Koo, an insurance investigator, is sent to make enquiries regarding a case of accidental death. He is surprised to learn that the victim is the same ghost who has spoken to him the night before. Koo is fascinated in working on the case. One night, Yu's spirit appeared in Koo's apartment. Her beauty and pleasant personality intrigued Koo. They get involved into a romance between man and a spirit. Will Koo and Yu be reunited or will Yu remain, as always, Koo's esprit d'amour?.

programme.title: A Chinese Ghost Story III
programme.desc: One stormy night, a wise High Priest and his student, Fong, pass by the Orchid Temple and realize it is haunted. Here, Fong encounters two lady demons, the seductive Lotus and her hated sister, Butterfly. Although Fong knows his Master wants to capture these evil spirits, he finds himself attracted to the Ghost and allows them to go free. The monks' stay at the Temple is prolonged due to Fong carelessly misplacing their valuable Taolisman, the Gold Suddna. During a trip to the corrupt local town, the High Priest meets Yin by chance and a series of misunderstandings evolve...

programme.title: E64
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.desc: The 96th Drama Serial is about Mineko, a girl born in Ibaraki Prefecture, who comes up to Tokyo for the mass employment during the high economic growth period. The story begins in 1964, the year of the Tokyo Olympics, and portrays her eventful life and growth as a person.

programme.title: E41
programme.desc: Inspired by the life of renowned novelist Uno Chiyo, who pursued freedom throughout the Meiji, Taisho, and Showa eras, this drama tells the story of Hano Tama (Ishibashi Shizuka). Born in Yamaguchi Prefecture in 1897, Tama moves to Tokyo and rekindles her childhood dream of becoming a writer. Through disasters, war, turbulent relationships, and financial struggles, she remains true to herself and forges her own path, eventually becoming a celebrated novelist whose life and work inspire generations.

programme.title: E17
programme.desc: In Hasami, Nagasaki Prefecture, ceramics are made through a division of labor among local craftspeople. Aoko (Matsui Rena), who grew up there and works as a porcelain painter, enjoys a quiet life until Tatsuki (Ichinose Hayate), a solitary potter, arrives from Finland. When he declares that his pottery needs no painted decoration, Aoko feels he is rejecting not only her work but her entire community. Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.

programme.title: E22 - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: E31 - The Stick Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels prepare for a campfire by collecting sticks of all sizes.

programme.title: E30 - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book. The Squirrels want to have a go too.

programme.title: E29 - The Harvest Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

programme.title: E31 - Boo Night
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck learn all about Boo Night and attempt to make their own scary costumes.

programme.title: E3 - Bubbles
programme.desc: Stanley cleans Cynthia's bus, but each time he does it keeps getting dirty again. It's so dirty by the end, he invents a super-duper cleaning machine that makes a sea of bubbles.

programme.desc: Myrtle's aunt Cressy is coming to stay, and she needs Stanley to make her a bed for her. This escalates into Stanley building her a whole set of rooms outside Myrtles actual house.

programme.title: E39 - It's Time To Spot The Birds
programme.desc: On a cold winter morning JoJo and Gran Gran are bird spotting. We also learn about bird migrations.

programme.title: E2 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Chilli sets up an obstacle course in the backyard, but Bluey is disheartened when Bandit turns it into a race and beats her. After cheating in a rematch, Bluey discovers the importance of training in order to improve her skills.

programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.desc: “Rapunzel”- Has-been idol Maggie had her career breakthrough with a famous advertisement featuring her hair. Though her career has waned considerably, a rare invitation to a movie audition sparks her longing for a comeback. On the night before the audition, Maggie's hair is burnt in a prank at a private party. To ensure that her damaged hair doesn't prevent her path back to stardom, Maggie finds a hair salon in the middle of the night... “Cheshire Cat”- A string of cat abuses shocks the city. Animal protection volunteers Nora and Aaron not only run a home for stray cats; they also go out and save them from the streets. One day, Johnnie, a man who tracks cat abusers, tells them about rumors of infamous cat abuser “Cat's Eye”... “Tooth Fairy”- Dental nurse Sammi ran into chef Hin after an incident on the street. programme.title: Tokyo Revengers 2 : Bloody Halloween-Finale
programme.desc: The intense battle between former friends, which poses a threat to the collapse of Tokyo Manji Gang, has finally begun. Mikey sets out to bring back Baji, who has defected to the enemy, Valhalla. Kazutora, who remains with Valhalla, aims to crush Tokyo Manji Gang and kill Mikey. The tragic past that tore apart the founding members of Tokyo Manji Gang and broke the bonds between the former comrades comes to light. 'I don't want anyone else to die!' Embracing their respective convictions, will Takemichi be able to prevent the worst outcome and create a brighter future? And can he once again save Hinata and the future of his friends?

programme.title: Vital Signs
programme.desc: After being reassigned to a new station along with his superior, Rock Sir, paramedic Wong Wai is assigned to ride with Jerry Ma. At first, Wai is worried that his work performance review would be affected because he doesn't agree with Jerry's way of working. But after some time, Jerry influences Wai to remember once again that the aim of paramedic work is to save every victim. Meanwhile, Jerry, a single father, is hesitating over the future of his daughter, Bonnie. He can't bear to see her leave, but he finally decides to send Bonnie to Canada for schooling. Before she leaves, she tells Jerry that she's worried about being forgotten when she's in Canada, just like her late mother was forgotten. Jerry tries to explain himself, but it's hard to digest such long-gestating grief. At the same time, a serious traffic accident occurs on Tuen Mun highway. Jerry immediately rushes to the scene for the rescue effort. When Wai notices that Rock Sir cares more about taking over command t

programme.title: Four Trails
programme.desc: At the time, they said it couldn't be done. In 2012, Andre Blumberg set off by himself, to run all four of Hong Kong's iconic ultra distance trails in just four days. 298km and over 14,500m of climbing later, one of the hardest ultra marathons in the world - the Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge - was born. With the 2021 edition of the challenge as the backdrop, 'Four Trails' takes you on a journey from when the concept was first was conceived to it's current format. Under 60 hours to be deemed a 'Finisher' and under 72 hours to be a ‘Survivor', unsupported and with an ever evolving set of rules. It takes a deep dive into the famous four trails that make up the challenge and you will both laugh and cry as the astonishing stories of those who dare attempt such a feat unfold.

programme.title: E13
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: E1 - South Australia
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.
